scope: Own API36 emulator only; browser controls only; original App/WebView and browser payloads archived by upstream backend.
sampling: Fixed pilot of two configurations, three clean/active/post rounds each. No retries or tuning; failed and skipped stages remain in the planned denominator.
pairing: App issues the ticket and launches Chrome. New ticket event selects the exact pair; original App runtime_context and collection_round bind to session; completed provenance and both raw archives must match exactly.
gate: Hold the original deferred browser-probe-adapter.js response. HTML, bootstrap and canonical core are served byte-for-byte first, so the real page realm is committed while adapter execution and DOMContentLoaded remain blocked. Install current-realm controls before releasing the identical adapter bytes. Core language/timezone reads occur within collect(), not module initialization. All static file paths are constrained to the public directory.
restoration: Delete the two language own-property overrides or reset timezone after a completed stage; close the exact probe target and require success=true, then force-stop Chrome and App before next stage. Record restoration commands. On an incomplete pair abort remaining slots and record them skipped without stopping App.
engineering_attempt: Public configuration template. Set a private device serial and a fresh neutral run identity before any capture; archived pilot_r8 measurements and source locks remain private.
interpretation: Pilot validates pairing, controlled observations and restoration, not population statistics or the old App177 denominator. Labels and control methods exist only in external plan/ledger.
